summary_en: TIS raised its fiscal 2027 dividend forecast by 2 yen per share to 47 yen for the year-end dividend, bringing total annual dividend to 92 yen per share, following upward revision of full-year operating profit guidance.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast (Upward Revision) and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
On November 4, 2026, TIS Inc. announced an upward revision of its fiscal 2027 consolidated earnings forecast and an increase to its year-end dividend forecast. The year-end dividend per share was raised by 2 yen from the previously announced 45 yen to 47 yen. Combined with the interim dividend of 45 yen per share already paid, the total annual dividend for fiscal 2027 is now 92 yen per share, compared to the prior forecast of 90 yen.

The company revised its full-year consolidated operating profit upward by 2.0 billion yen to 83.0 billion yen, reflecting stronger-than-expected performance in the interim period and favorable order conditions. Under its medium-term management plan (2024–2026), TIS targets balanced growth investment, financial soundness, and enhanced shareholder returns. The company increased its total return ratio guideline to 50 percent and commits to progressively enriching per-share dividends based on cash flows from operating activities rather than temporary profit fluctuations.

The dividend increase reflects management's confidence in sustained business growth and its strategic shift to enhance capital efficiency while maintaining financial health. The company continues to pursue orderly capital structure optimization as part of its engagement strategy with shareholders.
